sql.query: select COUNT(case ISNULL(answer, '') when '' then 1 end) non_cnt, COUNT(*) tot_cnt from dbo.tb_kabm_question where reg_ddtm between convert(datetime, convert(varchar(11), GETDATE() - 30, 120)+'00:00:00') and GETDATE()
select COUNT( case when reg_ddtm between convert(datetime, convert(varchar(11), GETDATE() - 30, 120)+'00:00:00') and GETDATE() then 1 end) rcnt_cnt, COUNT(*) tot_cnt from tb_kabm_board

select ISNULL(SUM(case when dd = convert(int, convert(varchar(2), GETDATE(), 3))then uv end), 0) today_uv_cnt, ISNULL(SUM(case when dd = convert(int, convert(varchar(2), GETDATE(), 3)) then pv end), 0) today_pv_cnt, ISNULL(SUM(uv), 0) tot_uv_cnt, ISNULL(SUM(pv), 0) tot_pv_cnt from dbo.tb_kabm_stat_view where yyyy = convert(varchar(4), GETDATE(), 120) and mm = convert(int, convert(varchar(2), GETDATE(), 101))
